### Horace Mann reports third-quarter 2026 results


November 3, 2026


SPRINGFIELD, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Horace Mann Educators Corporation (NYSE:HMN), the largest multiline financial services company focused on helping America’s educators and a core small- to mid-cap growth and value equity in the Financials sector, today reported financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026:


- Diversified business delivered third-quarter net income of $58.5 million, or $1.41 per share, and record core earnings* of $85.1 million, or $2.06 per share
- Net investment income increased 17% over prior year; premiums, contract charges and fee revenue increased 3%
- Third-quarter Property & Casualty segment combined ratio of 83.6% improved nearly 4 points over prior year
- Increased full-year 2026 core EPS guidance to $5.75-$5.95

See additional disclosure contained in Note 1 of the June 30, 2025 Form 10-Q.


"Horace Mann delivered the strongest quarterly core earnings in our history, reflecting excellent underwriting performance in our Property & Casualty business, higher net investment income, and continued growth across our diversified business," said Horace Mann President and CEO Marita Zuraitis. "Based on our performance through the first nine months of the year, we are increasing our full-year 2026 core EPS guidance to a range of $5.75 to $5.95. We continue to execute on our strategy to deliver sustained, profitable growth and remain well positioned to achieve our long-term financial objectives **.**


“Our strong value proposition is built on providing meaningful solutions across the markets we serve,” Zuraitis added. “We are helping educators achieve lifelong financial success while expanding the benefits and well-being solutions we provide to employers and their employees. Our diversified earnings base and strong balance sheet position Horace Mann to build on this momentum and accelerate long-term value creation for shareholders.”


Simultaneous with this release, the Quarterly Results page of[investors.horacemann.com](https://investors.horacemann.com/home/default.aspx) has been updated to include the third-quarter[investor supplement](https://investors.horacemann.com/Q3-2026-Investor-Supplement) and[investor presentation](https://investors.horacemann.com/Q3-2026-Earnings-Presentation) . These include details on company and segment financial performance, company guidance and outlook.


**Quarterly webcast**


Horace Mann’s senior management will discuss the company’s third-quarter financial results with investors on November 4, 2026 at 10:00 AM Eastern Time. The conference call will be webcast live at[investors.horacemann.com](https://investors.horacemann.com/home/default.aspx) and available later in the day for replay.


**About Horace Mann**


Horace Mann Educators Corporation (NYSE: HMN) is the largest multiline financial services company focused on helping America’s educators and others who serve the community achieve lifelong financial success. The company offers individual and group insurance and financial solutions tailored to the needs of the educational community. Founded by Educators for Educators® in 1945, Horace Mann is headquartered in Springfield, Illinois. For more information, visit[horacemann.com](https://horacemann.com/) .
